stateOwnerDisposition: The existing MatrixDurableStore owns per-Agent inbox, room/thread bindings, sync frontier, dispatch ledger, outbox and stable transaction identities; MatrixSendObserver has separate in-memory state only.
terminalObserverDisposition: The live sender records the homeserver send acknowledgement event ID as OutboxState::Sent. This proves that acknowledgement, not recipient reading or a separately observed sync echo. MatrixSendObserver models a stronger observation target but is not wired to the live sender or a trusted observer.

operations.sourceSemantics: Loads one already durable inbox event and dispatches or reconciles it through the owning Agent App Server. Live sync admission, dedupe, redaction and frontier advancement are composed earlier by MatrixSdkClient and MatrixSyncComposer through MatrixDurableStore; process_event does not own the sync cursor.

In-memory observer validates supplied identity, deadline and payload/grant digest equality, then binds one transaction. It neither verifies independently issued authority nor prepares the live durable outbox.

In-memory observer checks a supplied observation against the prepared transaction and preserves nonterminal uncertainty. It neither authenticates the observer nor records a live homeserver observation in the durable outbox.

repositoryControlledGaps: Bind the live SDK send boundary to independently issued current operation/room/final-payload authority and revocation; room/revision/generation checks and observer digest equality are not VerifiedUseToken consumption.
